records.label: GeoImpact-CI README, current public contract inspected 2026-10-24

facts.PASS: The configured relationship-regression policy was not exceeded; PASS is not a claim that source data are correct.
facts.BLOCK: The analysis completed and the configured policy threshold was exceeded; BLOCK is not an operational failure.
facts.ERROR: An operational, configuration, or input error prevented a policy verdict; no report verdict is produced.
facts.limitations: Spatial membership does not establish source correctness, legal status, causality, access, service use, or socioeconomic effects.
facts.uncertainty: The documented 1e-6 m grids are computational representation/robustness choices, not source positional accuracy.
facts.provenance: SHA-256 hashes identify raw input bytes but do not embed source files or identify who supplied them; the report has no source-license field.

facts.relationships: Dependent Point relationships use exact WITHIN predicates; boundary touches are reported separately and do not count as within.
facts.changes: Primary feature IDs are classified as unchanged, modified, added, or removed; no rename or identity is inferred across IDs.
facts.displacement: Maximum boundary displacement is computed only for modified shared IDs present in both snapshots; additions and removals have no counterpart.
facts.v4_v5: V4 includes the complete primary ID change section; V5 adds input-byte SHA-256 identities and engine versions without changing scientific semantics.
facts.error: ERROR means no policy verdict was produced.

records.label: Local GeoImpact-CI V4/V5 input schema shipped with this prototype

facts.uncertainty: The supported report fields do not include a calibrated uncertainty interval, confidence value, or source positional accuracy field.
facts.rights: The supported report fields do not include source license or data-rights metadata.
facts.source_locations: The supported report fields do not include source URLs or local input paths.
facts.scope: This prototype validates GeoImpact-CI report versions 4 and 5 only; V5 requires the provenance object and V4 omits it.
